correctness.rationale: Direct proof: scalar derivative integral centered at zero yields the sharp real monotonicity coefficient 2^(2-p). Summation and Holder yield lower duality-map distance; explicit two-coordinate unit vectors attain it for all 0<d<=2. Hessian of the norm on the unit-sphere a<=1/2 neighborhood is bounded by 2(p-1)||z||^2, giving remainder <=(p-1)a^2 for each unit vector, hence for differences and both extrema. The statement is for real spaces only. Rational finite grid checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The original quantitative Steinhaus modulus is a central defined geometric invariant in the motivating 2026 study. Its ell_p p>2 behavior was left at order of magnitude; the result gives the exact sharp coefficient at each separation, a global dimension-free quadratic remainder and explicit 2-coordinate extremizers. This fixes a usable benchmark for uniform (S) estimates and a sharp comparison with the paper’s atomless L1 formula. No new general property-(S) theorem is claimed.
